label: A quote the tape cannot support
why: The engine refuses before it starts when the history behind a position is too thin to quote from. It is the most important thing this site does and the hardest to reach on demand: it needs a wallet whose positions are real and whose tape is short.

detail.error: the tape supports 6 windows and 18 observations; the floor is 20 windows and 30 observations
detail.remedy: index more history for this pool — `make indexer POOL=<address>` — and ask again
detail.note: A range quoted from 18 observations is not a narrower range, it is a wider one drawn narrow. Assumption A5 and the floors on /methods.
